title: Return Methods, Ship-By Days and Changed-Mind Return Fees by Channel — Northgate Purchases & Returns
content:
Northgate Purchases & Returns merchandise goes back either over a club membership counter or, without a club visit, under a return authorization by one of the methods its channel lists. This sheet gives, per channel, the counter terms, the authorization methods, the classes that travel by freight pickup, the ship-by days, and the two fees that can fall on a changed-mind return.

## Methods and timing

| Channel | Returnable at any club membership counter | Methods available through a return authorization | Classes that go back by freight pickup | Calendar days after confirmation to hand the merchandise to the carrier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Club Purchase | yes | none (club counter only) | none | 0 (no authorizations issued) |
| Northgate Club Pickup Order | yes | none (club counter only) | none | 0 (no authorizations issued) |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order | yes | none (club counter only) | none | 0 (no authorizations issued) |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | yes | carrier pickup; prepaid label; freight pickup | major appliance; mattress and furniture | 14 |
| Northgate Business Delivery Order | yes | freight pickup | major appliance; mattress and furniture; general merchandise; grocery | 7 |
| Northgate Special Order | no | freight pickup | major appliance; mattress and furniture; television; general merchandise | 10 |

## Changed-mind return fees

| Channel | Changed-mind freight pickup fee (USD) | Restocking fee on a changed-mind return (percent of the returned amount) |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Club Purchase | 0.00 | 0 |
| Northgate Club Pickup Order | 0.00 | 0 |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order | 0.00 | 0 |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 0.00 | 0 |
| Northgate Business Delivery Order | 0.00 | 0 |
| Northgate Special Order | 79.00 | 15 |

On every channel, neither fee is ever charged when the return reason is defective, not as described, damaged in transit, missing parts or not received.

## Notes

- The Northgate Special Order is the only channel whose merchandise cannot be handed in at any club counter, and the only channel with a non-zero changed-mind pickup fee (79.00) and restocking percentage (15 percent).
- An empty method list means returns are made at a club counter only.

Hypothetical reading: on the Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order a mattress travels back by freight pickup, while a blender may go back by carrier pickup or prepaid label, as the member chooses.
